# Support

Free, non-commercial personal project. No support, no service levels, and no commitment to maintenance or updates.

Provided as is, without warranty of any kind. Check all results before you rely on them. See sections 15 and 16 of the GPL-3.0.

- **Help yourself first.** The installation notes are in [`HarnessDesignStudio/docs/INSTALL.md`](../HarnessDesignStudio/docs/INSTALL.md), common problems and their fixes in [`HarnessDesignStudio/docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md`](../HarnessDesignStudio/docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md) and [`HarnessDesignStudio/docs/FAQ.md`](../HarnessDesignStudio/docs/FAQ.md).
- **Issues are welcome.** A problem report or a question may be opened as a GitHub issue. It is answered at the owner's discretion, or not at all. Nobody owes you an answer, a fix, a date or an update.
- **Vulnerabilities** are reported privately: see [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md).
- **No paid help.** The project has no paid support, no service levels and no contact for services ([decision D-206](../HarnessDesignStudio/docs/DECISIONS.md)).
- **WireViz.** Questions about WireViz itself belong to the [WireViz project](https://github.com/wireviz/WireViz).
